notes.title: Version 1.0.0 Full Release
notes.content:
A brand new wave-based zombies game mode has been added for 1-8 players. This update marks the full release of Guns N Stuff 2 so please enjoy!

[h2]Zombies Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] 9 different zombie types
[*] 3 zombie bosses
[*] Roguelite items system
[/list]

What round can you get to?

notes.title: Version 0.4.0
notes.content:
[h1]Version 0.4.0[/h1]

[h2]New Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added weapon selection (Customize what weapons spawn)
[*] Host can now adjust map selection and newly added weapon selection in game
[*] Added hitmarker
[*] Added option to end game after player reaches certain amount of wins
[*] Added option for host to end game at anytime while in-game and return everyone to lobby
[/list]
[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed some turrets from a few of the lava world levels to improve fps
[*] Reduced camera shake for explosions
[*] Upped movement speed when holding melee weapon
[*] If throwing a weapon while looking at the ground, you will now lightly drop it rather than throwing it and having it bounce away
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41750079/fbab30e29b1184d0223975e5925ef737887d2822.png[/img]

notes.title: Version 0.3.3 - 8 Player Support / Map Selection
notes.content:

notes.title: Version 0.2.1
notes.content:
- Fixed exploit with slide mechanic allowing you to run while aiming.
- Added an inverse mouse option to the controls section.
- Fixed Hold to Aim option not saving.

notes.title: Version 0.2.0 - Movement Update
notes.content:
[b]Crouching[/b]

Want to duck under bullets? Well, now you can. Using crouch will additionally hide your nametag.

[b]Sliding[/b]

Simply crouch while running and you will slide away. Slide into your opponents for some damage and knock back or slide as fast as you can away from your enemies.

[b]Double Jumps[/b]

There is now a setting in the pregame lobby settings to enable double jumps for added movement capabilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41750079/202d8a96df9ec203d440f5e45f33c7f1e2f7c1b8.png[/img]

notes.title: Version 0.1.2
notes.content:
- Buffed damage of freeze ray from 15 to 25.
- Fixed a glitch where reload notify would incorrectly appear.
- Greatly improved throw distance of weapons.
- Fixed sound settings randomly resetting.

notes.title: Version 0.1.1 - Patches
notes.content:
- Buffed damage of Egg Launcher from 15 damage to 25 damage.
- Buffed the range, damage, and strength of the Death Vaccum.
- Fixed a glitch where picking up a weapon while also having one equipped would cause the equipped weapon to disappear completely. (It now drops on the ground)
- More weapons spawn at the start of each map.
